decisions.quote:
We estimate the equations first using the data reported
by HMOR and then using the corrected data reported in Table 1.
       We are able to replicate HMOR’s results when we use the data reported by
HMOR.
decisions.reason: Re-running HMOR's regression equations on the dataset reported in HMOR's Table 1 reproduced the original results. The source and transcription errors documented by the authors concern the construction of the underlying variables, which are evaluated in the subsequent corrected-data robustness re-analysis rather than failing the computational reproduction of the reported estimates.
